g.text: National improvement hides a persistent eastern-region problem

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Lower weekly error is better · these models trained on all three regions in 2012–2019

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Eastern weakness is already visible in validation. This is separate from the harder cold-geography test:

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: when the east is entirely held out from training, daily ML has +165.3% aggregate bias.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563
